originalTitle: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Launch Trailer
content: Assemble your team of iconic Marvel Heroes and Villains in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, the Ultimate 4v4 Tag-Team Fighter! The Champion has set his sights on Earth. Build your dream team of legendary Marvel characters, unleash explosive 4v4 tag battles, and rise to his challenge to save the planet. Fight your way through ranked online matches, challenge friends in local battles, experience five original stories in Episode Mode, explore the Online Lobby, and master a launch roster of 20 iconic Marvel characters. MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available August 6 on PlayStation 5 and PC (Steam & Epic Games Store).

chineseContent: 在《MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls》终极 4v4 双打格斗游戏中，组建由标志性 Marvel 英雄和反派组成的团队！冠军将目光投向了地球。组建你的传奇漫威角色梦之队，发动爆炸性的 4v4 标签战斗，迎接拯救地球的挑战。在排名在线比赛中杀出一条血路，在本地战斗中挑战朋友，在情节模式中体验五个原创故事，探索在线大厅，并掌握 20 个标志性 Marvel 角色的首发名单。 MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls 将于 8 月 6 日在 PlayStation 5 和 PC（Steam 和 Epic Games Store）上发售。
